issue_request: FHIR-13897 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 OO request to replace the bodyweight profile's vital-signs Observation.category invariant with fixed values; the accepted resolution clarified that slicing was preferred so alternative codings would remain possible.

reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current Vital Signs Base Profile slices Observation.category with open rules and a vital-signs pattern slice, which bodyweight inherits, matching the FHIR-13897 rationale without forbidding additional codings.
